summary: SeaStar Medical Holding Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose the dismissal with prejudice of a securities class action lawsuit filed in July 2024. The suit alleged material misstatements and omissions related to a financial restatement. On April 27, 2026, the court ordered dismissal with prejudice per the parties' stipulation. No deal terms, tender offers, or special-situation transactions are involved. The filing is a routine litigation update with no strategic or structural event.
